Byte 7 of CCVS message; composed from switch_16 bits 5-7 mapped to J1939 status positions (0xC0 base with optional 0x10/0x04/0x01)

Determines STCG enable XOR behavior: when 1 and throttle interlock set, STCG=0; when 0 and interlock set, STCG=1; directly assigned to STCG enable in fuelBlendTablePointerSetup

added as offset to blended fuel table lookup result in calculateBlendedTableValue and throttle fuel calculation
Primary redundant checksum for EEPROM calibration data validation; compared against secondary copy (fe4) in validateRedundantSensors; written as sum of fea+fec via parameterCircularBufferWrite
Secondary redundant checksum for EEPROM calibration data; compared against primary (fe2) to detect data corruption; synced to primary via parameterCircularBufferWrite on mismatch

secondary powerdown data loss counter incremented on mismatch and added to vp44_reset_count for total

Count of entries in fault-to-lamp tracking list in hourMeterEventLogger; incremented when fault with lamp mapping activates, decremented when deactivated
Incremented when engine operating state equals 0x12; reset to zero on statistics clear; likely counts cranking or start attempts
Calibration value defining throttle sensor operating range; added to low idle offset for upper bound and to 4 for initial minimum throttle
Calibration offset for throttle low idle position; used as baseline in throttle percentage calculations and range checks
compared < 2 for table init position and divided by 6 for timer register and by period_meas_per_cam for prescaler - represents total timer counts for speed measurement
always added to crank_exit_fuel_adjustment in fuel limit and timing table lookups during cranking
used as upper bound on reference_speed_before_droop and reported in J1708 diagnostic message 46 scaled by /0x50

multiplied by duty cycle and converted to timer counts for PWM3 output channel
multiplied by duty cycle and converted to timer counts for PWM4 output channel

second deviation metric clamped +/-10000 paired with deviation_a

array of 16 shorts by rpm bin initialized to 10000 paired with array_a

set to 1 when high rpm protection activates with logging enabled cleared on exit
computed by coreTableInterpolation and compared against thresholds in table to determine alpha blend return value

Flag controlling bit 3 (0x08) of enable_flag_to_allow_boot_block_programming; set and cleared during startup and shutdown sequences

timer counting toward oil drain-back time threshold after engine off

Drivers demand (4d fueling) as percentage of injectable range scaled by 0x6400 and clamped to 32000 - based on 4d_fueling minus no-fuel threshold
